rv.q: Its comedic tone is undefined: not uncanny enough to be absurd, insufficiently self-reflexive to be knowingly ironic, and not remotely cutting enough to satirise what it sometimes seems to be mocking.
Underpowered musical play about failed ambitions by Alana Ramsey, Lizzie Stables and Jenny Rainsford
But although Ramsey and Stables work up a toe-tapping rhythm at times, over the hour-and-a-half length of the show the musical segments do come across as rather thin on the ground.

cn.t: This comedy with music about nanny double-act dreamers delivers pleasing performances but lacks sharp satirical focus, resulting in a mixed reception that shows promise without fully delivering on its premise.
